meta.label: Earth-2: run forecast
meta.description: Download the initial atmospheric state (ERA5 or GFS) for the selected model, send it to the FourCastNet NIM, and store the forecast steps and a manifest in a managed folder.

inputRoles.name: dates
inputRoles.label: Init times (optional)
inputRoles.description: Dataset with a timestamp column, for batch backfills: one forecast per timestamp. Overrides the init time mode.

outputRoles.name: forecast
outputRoles.label: Forecast folder
outputRoles.description: Receives runs/init=<time>/manifest.json and steps/*.npy (and inputs/ when no initial conditions folder is connected)

outputRoles.name: initial_conditions
outputRoles.label: Initial conditions folder (optional)
outputRoles.description: Where downloaded initial conditions are cached ({source}/{model_id}/{YYYYmmddTHH}.npy). If not connected, they go under inputs/ in the forecast folder.

params.name: gfs_safety_margin_hours
params.label: GFS safety margin (h)
params.description: How far behind now the latest GFS cycle is assumed to be published

params.name: time_mode
params.label: Init time
params.description: Ignored when an init times dataset is connected

params.name: dates_column
params.label: Init time column
params.description: Only used when an init times dataset is connected

params.name: simulation_length
params.label: Simulation length (steps)
params.description: Number of 6-hour steps. N steps produce N+1 files (lead 0 is the initial state)

params.name: variables
params.label: Variables
params.description: Comma-separated. Leave empty for all model variables (~300 MB per step)

params.name: fail_on_partial
params.label: Fail on partial forecast
params.description: If unchecked, a stream that breaks after at least one step keeps the partial run and the recipe succeeds with a warning
